_approach: Rolling/peak-time techno built the way Attack's Rolling Techno dissection lays it out: the kick gets a soft ghost hit just before beats 2 and 4 for a pendulum push, alternating low/mid toms mark every quarter, a fast closed 16th hat drives underneath, and the open hat answers on 2 and 4 at reduced velocity. The clap sits in the pocket with low-velocity ghosts either side for a humanized roll. This is the club-ready, ride-the-groove-for-eight-bars engine of peak time. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
